stem.alt: Flowchart of four boxes connected top to bottom by downward arrows: A → B → C → D. Beside each box is a description. A: The orderer indicates the purpose of the systemization and the details of the business to a vendor, and requests provision of information. B: The orderer indicates the system that is the target of the procurement and conditions of the procurement to a vendor, and requests submission of a proposal document. C: The orderer determines a procurement source on the basis of the proposal document and capabilities of the vendor. D: The orderer and the procurement source mutually confirm their roles and the assignment of responsibilities on a document.
